note: Symbols to pull from Yahoo Finance (yfinance). Index ^ prefix, crypto -USD, NSE stocks .NS. Override with --symbols.
caveat: Yahoo does NOT carry most NSE sector indices - ^CNXAUTO, ^CNXFMCG, ^CNXMETAL, ^CNXENERGY, ^CNXPSUBANK, ^CNXREALTY and friends return ~0 rows. Use the NSE bhavcopy / index files for sector data instead. Symbols returning under 50 rows are skipped automatically.
